$comment: Copy/paste guard for apps/api/src and packages/shared/src (npm run check:clones passes the paths; a path list in this file is ignored by jscpd 4 when the checkout lives under a dot-directory). Fails when duplicated lines exceed threshold percent. apps/web is left out of the threshold for now: the web half of the reuse plan (course-sales screens, UI primitives, web formatters) is deferred while the UI is redesigned. The threshold sits just above the level reached by the reuse plan (0.19% in Nov 2026); lower it as clones go, never raise it.
